From: Maria Suciu <maria.suciu@crpe.ro>
To: cumparlegume@gmail.com
Subject: Parteneriat de practică pentru elevii din liceele agricole – sprijin pentru diseminarea campaniei
Attachments: Brosura Practica.pdf

Stimată Doamnă, stimate Domn,

Centrul Romând de Politici Europene (CRPE), ca parte a consorțiului 
Creștem prin Educație Agricolă (CEA), a lansat inițiativa „Ai o afacere 
agricolă ? Ia elevi în practică !", un demers care urmărește să răspundă 
uneia dintre principalele vulnerabilități ale învățământului agricol: 
accesul limitat și inconsistent al elevilor la stagii de practică 
relevante.

Proiectul, dedicat facilitării colaborării între liceele agricole și 
afacerile agricole/fermierii din România, are scopul de a consolida 
experiența practică a elevilor și de a sprijini reînnoirea generațională 
în agricultură.

CRPE îi încurajează pe cei care dețin afaceri în agricultură să-și 
deschidă fermele către învățământul agricol, acesta fiind în cel mai bun 
moment din ultimii ani. Trei sferturi (75%) din companiile din domeniu 
chestionate de CRPE ar vrea să colaboreze cu liceele agricole, dar nu au 
suficiente informații despre ce presupune primirea elevilor în practica 
de specialitate

Așadar, în cadrul inițiativei, am creat două instrumente principale:

  	* Ghidul fermierului [1]- o broșură simplă de parcurs, care explică 
beneficiile și modalitatea de implicare în practica elevilor;
  	* Formularul de înscriere [2] - prin care companiile agricole își pot 
exprima disponibilitatea de a primi elevi în practică.

Aceste instrumente ne permit să construim o bază de date actualizată a 
fermierilor, pe care o punem la dispoziția liceelor agricole. Liceele 
vor folosi această bază pentru a contacta fermierii și a stabili 
parteneriate de practică pentru elevi.

Cunoscând implicarea și conexiunile dumneavoastră în industria de 
agribusiness, am fi recunoscători dacă ați putea disemina aceste 
instrumente în rândul fermierilor din rețeaua dumneavoastră, contribuind 
astfel la consolidarea legăturii dintre educația agricolă și sectorul 
productiv, și la susținerea reînnoirii generaționale în fermă.

From: The Newsletter Plugin <noreply@thenewsletterplugin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Don't Miss Our Recent Developments

A set of updates to make your workflow smoother and more powerful. 

The Newsletter Plugin

What’s Changed 

See our premium plans  (https://www.thenewsletterplugin.com/premium) 

We’ve been busy behind the scenes, and we’re  back with a series of new interesting features . Take a look to find out several adjustments and innovative possibilities to make your newsletters even better . 

Yearly Messages Addon 

A new experimental addon to set up recurring yearly messages . It's a very niche use case, but interesting for a full automation year-by-year. 

It supports non-fixed-date events, like Easter and Black Friday. 

Find it on your site Newsletter/Addons page or in the Download section of your account  (https://www.thenewsletterplugin.com/account) . 

Automated Addon 

The monthly schedule has been improved by adding the selection of the months, so you can now, for example, create a bimonthly automated newsletter (or any other combination). 

A "calendar view" has been added for a clearer overview of the days when the automated newsletter is sent. 

Unsubscribe flow 

We improved the security of the cancellation flow and added stricter blocks against bots and mail scanners producing unwanted cancellations. 

Review your unsubscribe configuration and update it to use the shortcodes. 

Buttons 

Buttons inside the Composer can now be squared, fully rounded or with a specific border radius. 

Custom CSS for newsletters 

Custom CSS can now be added to your newsletters . See the Newsletter/Settings configuration. Of course, you know not all email clients will render them, but it's worth trying. 

Tags and Placeholders 

We added a configurable fallback for the "name" and "full_name" tags when the subscriber is missing the first and last names. 

See more about tags  (https://www.thenewsletterplugin.com/documentation/newsletters/newsletter-tags/#subscriber-tags) . 

Extended blocks 

New RSS block to import content from an R

From: Medicover Recrutare<recrutare@medicover.ro>
To: office@factoryjobs.eu
Subject: Multumim pentru aplicatie !

Bună ziua!
 
În acest moment parcurgem toate CV-urile primite și le analizăm cu atenție în căutarea candidaților potriviți. Dacă experiența și abilitățile dumneavoastra ne sugerează că va potriviti poziției, vom reveni cu mai multe detalii despre interviu, test sau următorul pas în procesul de recrutare.

Vă informăm că prin transmiterea aplicației dumneavoastră întelegem că v-ați exprimat în mod liber și neechivoc consimtământul privind furnizarea informațiilor necesare derulării procesului de selecție și recrutare cu MEDICOVER.

Precizăm că informații cuprinse în CV -ul depus ce urmează a fi prelucrate în scopul derulării procesului de selecție și recrutare, sunt: nume prenume,data nașterii, adresa email, număr de telefon, adresa de resedință, studii, experiența profesională, fotografia, alte informații cuprinse în CV, alte informații furnizate în cadrul interviului sau al testelor de aptitudini și abilități. 
Datele cu caracter personal vor fi stocate pentru o perioadă limitată de timp, stabilită în conformitate cu politicile interne. Astfel, în cazul candidaților respinși, datele vor fi stocate în conformitate cu interesul legitim al societății, pentru o perioadă de 6 luni de la începerea procesului de recrutare, pentru eventuala soluționare a unor plângeri sau solicitări.

În cazul în care avem acordul dumneavoastră pentru a vă contacta pentru viitoare proiecte de recrutare care să fie compatibile cu experiența și asteptările dvs., vom păstra datele pentru o perioadă de 24 de luni de la finalizarea procesului de recrutare.

Ca și candidat aveți următoarele drepturi: dreptul de acces, dreptul la rectificare, dreptul la ștergerea datelor (dreptul de a fi uitat), dreptul la restricționarea prelucrării, dreptul la opoziție.
Consimțământul cu privire la contactarea ulterioară poate fi retras oricând. Retragerea consimțământului nu afectează legalitatea prelucrării pe baza consimțământului înainte de retragerea acestuia.

Mulțumim,
Echipa de Recrutare

Expeditor: Marinela Culea <marinelaculea94@gmail.com>
Destinatar: George Oancea <george.oancea@adizmb.ro>, 
"moaradomneasca@usamv.ro" <moaradomneasca@usamv.ro>,

Stimați parteneri, părinți, elevi și reprezentanți ai mediului
economic,

Avem deosebita plăcere de a vă invita să participați la evenimentul
dedicat Zilei Naționale a Meseriilor, organizat în data de 11 martie
2026, în intervalul orar 10:00 – 12:30.

Evenimentul are ca scop consolidarea legăturii dintre educație și
piața muncii, prin dialog direct între furnizorii de educație,
beneficiarii direcți ai sistemului (elevi și părinți) și operatorii
economici interesați.

1️Seminar de conștientizare

Prezentarea planului de îmbunătățire a cunoașterii cerințelor și
condițiilor concrete de pe piața muncii, prin:

  	* implicarea operatorilor economici;
  	* adaptarea ofertei educaționale la nevoile reale ale angajatorilor;
  	* facilitarea dialogului școală – elev – părinte – angajator;
  	* promovarea învățării la locul de muncă.

2️ Atelier de lucru

Obiective:

🔹 O1: Îmbunătățirea gradului de cunoaștere a cerințelor și
condițiilor concrete de pe piața muncii.

🔹 O2: Creșterea gradului de conștientizare asupra importanței,
avantajelor, necesității, posibilităților de acces și beneficiilor
participării elevilor la programele de învățare la locul de muncă.

📎 Formularul de înscriere este atașat prezentei invitații.
Vă rugăm să îl completați și să îl transmiteți până la data
de 06.03.2026, pentru o mai bună orga

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Brown rice and status

View Online
________________________________________________________

Brown rice and status [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=534106477&f=1081591&c=27611101&u=77607765 ]

Rice is one of the most consumed foods in the world, and it gives us insight into our relentless search for status and for affiliation.

Once rice is harvested for consumption, it's brown. The outer layers of the rice husk contain the bran and many of the nutrients in the rice. And yet, most people, including many of the poorest people in any population, only eat white rice.

White rice takes more work to prepare for sale and leaves behind the vitamin-rich bran. We need to harvest more brown rice to make a single serving of white.

The origin of milling rice has to do with storage. Brown rice goes rancid much sooner, particularly in warm climates. As a result, white rice is more reliable–you're not going to serve a bad batch.

The reliability led to status. Status in serving it and in consuming it. You might not have much, but at least you can eat white rice.

Once that signal is established, it becomes a sign of cultural affiliation. If your family or neighbors are doing it, it's important to fit in. People insist that white rice is normal and that they prefer it, but that's only because of their history and culture.

When white rice became a popular commodity and a signal, the demand for brown rice went down. Now it's a specialty item, and that increases the price, apparently contradicting the very signal about status that made it unusual in the first place. (For some folks, the rarity, healthiness and price of brown rice make it a new sort of status symbol).

With improved supply chains and storage, brown rice is nearly as resilient as white rice is now, but the cultural trope remains. And because people like what they like, we've learned to prefer the blander flavor of the rice we were raised with.

To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Should you keep playing your hit song?

View Online
________________________________________________________

Should you keep playing your hit song? [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=534315909&f=1081591&c=27631389&u=77607765 ]

It depends.

A freelancer, a brand, a musician–they're here to serve. If people come to the restaurant for your famous marinara sauce, if new clients hire you to architect your signature style home or they want to dance to your top 40 hit, that's what you're here for.

Brands shouldn't change their logo or their offerings when they get bored. They should do it when their accountant gets bored.

Unless…

Unless you're an artist who doesn't want to become a cover band of their former self.

Unless you use the frontier as fuel for creating more value in the long run.

Unless you're no longer proud of what you used to do.

That hit is a gift from your former self. Like all gifts, you don't have to accept it.

In addition to sunk costs, there are sunk benefits. Just because an asset belongs to you doesn't mean you have to use it. • Email to a friend •

Sarcasm self-defeats [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=534527897&f=1081591&c=27657345&u=77607765 ]

Sarcasm is an easy way to amplify feedback.

It has two hidden costs:

- It reveals low status. People with power don't need to use sarcasm to make a point. If you want to lead with status, using sarcasm undermines that goal.
- It adds emotion where it's not always needed. The emotion is an amplifier, but it often causes division and defensiveness.

If you have confidence in your standing and your idea, then sarcasm is simply getting in the way, because it undermines both. • Email to a friend •

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Time is the wildcard

View Online
________________________________________________________

Time is the wildcard [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=534680309&f=1081591&c=27675817&u=77607765 ]

There are two feet of snow blocking your car from the road. This is a problem.

Except it's not a problem if you don't need to leave the house for a few days—the snow will melt on its own.

And it's not a problem if you had decided to move to the island of Saba a few years ago. It never snows there.

Traffic on the way to an important meeting is only a problem because we didn't leave twenty minutes earlier. The rent that's hard to cover after a vacation—same thing.

The real world feels like the source of our problems. But our decisions over time might be the actual culprits, hiding in the corner.

Instead of treating time as a given and the real world as an impediment, what happens if we accept the real world and make different decisions about time? • Email to a friend •

From: "Sebastian M. via CampaniaMea pe Declic" <campaniamea@declic.ro>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Următorii pași după ședința  PMB –  propunere de pichetare

Bună ziua,

După ședința de ieri a PMB, în care luarea mea de cuvânt a fost
ignorată, iar subiectul facturilor a fost tratat superficial,
cred că este momentul să discutăm următorii pași.

PMB pare hotărâtă să ne oblige în continuare să plătim pentru
servicii de care nu am beneficiat. De aceea, vă propun
organizarea unei acțiuni de pichetare în fața Primăriei
Municipiului București.

Am nevoie de opinia voastră pentru a putea merge mai departe
organizat:

* În ce perioadă doriți să organizăm pichetarea? Vă rog să
trimiteți propuneri de dată și interval orar. Voi centraliza
răspunsurile, iar apoi, împreună cu cei ce vor dori să participe

From: Mădălina - StartCo  <newsletter@startco.ro>
To: fruitnature4@gmail.com
Subject: Ai trecut la CAEN Rev. 3?

Plus: Ce riști dacă nu depui bilanțul la timp, cine e obligat să plătească TVA retroactiv și cum să-ți pui afacerea pe pilot automat  

****************
Tot ce contează
****************

StartCo - Newsletter pentru antreprenori
----------------------------------------

🔍 Subiectele săptămânii, pe scurt
---------------------------------------

* Întârzierea bilanțului = inactivitate fiscală ⏱️
* Decizii de impunere pentru TVA necolectat 🧾
* Ce amenzi riști dacă n-ai cont de plăți sau POS? 📲
* Ce trebuie să știi despre conversia codurilor CAEN la Rev. 3 📌

📋 Ce s-a mai schimbat
------------------------

Dacă întârzii bilanțul, riști să-ți fie anulat codul de TVA (și nu numai) ⚠️

Din 2026, o firmă poate fi declarată inactivă fiscal dacă nu depune situațiile financiare anuale într-un termen de maximum 5 luni după termenul legal de depunere. Verificarea se face pentru situațiile financiare al căror termen legal este în 2026 (deci nu retroactiv).

📌 Ce trebuie să reții:

* Pentru multe firme, termenul menționat de ANAF pentru situațiile financiare este 31 mai; pentru alte persoane juridice, 30 aprilie (și există termene separate pentru cei cu exercițiu financiar diferit).
* Dacă ești declarat inactiv și ești plătitor de TVA, se anulează codul de TVA de la data comunicării deciziei.
* În perioada cu TVA anulat, dacă totuși desfășori activitate, ai obligația să colectezi TVA, dar nu ai drept de deducere. TVA-ul colectat se declară și se plătește până la 25 a lunii următoare celei în care a devenit exigibil.
* Inactivitatea se înscrie în cazierul fiscal (și poate bloca operațiuni la ONRC).
* Chiar dacă ești inactiv, obligațiile de declarare și plată rămân în vigoare.

Ca să eviți inactivitatea fiscală, setează un reminder pentru bilanț, atât pentru tine, cât și pentru contabil. Iar dacă ai primit vreo notificare/decizie, reacționează rapid, pentru că efectele sunt mai scumpe decât efortul de conformare.

Posibilă amnistie pentru antreprenor

Creierul uman funcționează pe bază de tipare. Aproximativ 90–95% din deciziile noastre zilnice sunt influențate de procese automate, formate în primii ani de viață.

– vrei abundență,*** dar te simți inconfortabil când începe să apară.***


Mintea caută coerență, nu neapărat performanță.

lichenul usnea beneficii :Lichenul Usnea (cunoscut popular ca „barba-tatălui-vântului” sau Old Man's Beard) este un lichen utilizat tradițional în fitoterapie, recunoscut pentru proprietățile sale puternic antimicrobiene, antifungice și imunostimulatoare. Datorită conținutului ridicat de acid usnic, acesta funcționează ca un antibiotic natural. Sursa : National Institutes of Health (.gov)Iată principalele beneficii și utilizări ale lichenului Usnea:1. Sistemul Respirator și ImunitateAcțiune expectorantă și calmantă: Este utilizat pentru ameliorarea tusei, bronșitei și calmarea durerilor de gât.Tratarea infecțiilor: Ajută la reducerea congestiei și inflamației din căile respiratorii, fiind indicat în caz de flegmă, răceli și infecții pulmonare.Stimularea sistemului imunitar: Extractele de Usnea sunt folosite pentru a crește rezistența organismului la infecții. Sursa : Medicover2. Proprietăți Antimicrobiene (Antibiotic Natural)Acțiune anti-stafilococică: Acidul usnic este eficient împotriva bacteriilor gram-pozitive, inclusiv Staphylococcus aureus și Streptococcus, fiind util în infecții rezistente.Acțiune antifungică: Eficient în combaterea Candida albicans. Sursa : ScienceDirect.com3. Utilizare Externă (Wound Healing)Vindecarea rănilor: Datorită proprietăților antiseptice, ceaiul sau extractul de Usnea este folosit pentru spălarea rănilor, tratarea infecțiilor cutanate, a arsurilor și a ulcerațiilor.Efect antiinflamator: Reduce inflamația și roșeața pielii. Sursa = planta-medicinala ro4. Alte BeneficiiAfecțiuni gastrointestinale: Tradițional, este utilizat pentru a calma durerile de stomac, diareea și problemele biliare.Infecții urinare: Folosit pentru a trata infecțiile vezicii urinare și ale tractului urinar. Sursa : Science

Launching background-agents.com

Launching background-agents.com
-------------------------------

A visual guide to self-driving codebases

Recently an article titled 'something big is happening' went viral.

It was a wake-up call to those not in the tech industry about how AI has hit this inflection point, since December 2025. It does a great job of putting into words what those of us keeping up with the frontier of coding AI feel: an inflection point, and like things are 'going exponential'.

I feel it, and see it in my own GitHub contributions graph.

The bottleneck of software development has shifted violently. The bottleneck isn't writing code anymore. And if it still is for you, it won't be for long.

Now, everyone is wrestling with the idea of parallel agents, sandboxing and worktrees or even buying multiple Macs to run more agents in parallel. The longer you invest in coding agents without addressing the system around it, the deeper you entrench. This is the false summit.

The false summit of background agents

As agent autonomy has increased, the interest in 'background agents' has intensified, yet many are still confused about what they are, how they work, and where the industry is heading.

That's why today we are announcing: background-agents.com.

**COMUNICAT ****DE**** PRESĂ**

Fundația pentru Apărarea Cetățenilor Împotriva Abuzurilor Statului (FACIAS) continuă lupta pentru dreptate în cazul lui Andrei Drăgan, adolescentul de 16 ani lăsat să moară în spitalul din Târgu Jiu în noiembrie 2024, după ce medicii care ar fi trebuit să îi salveze viața au refuzat să îl opereze. 28 février 2026
Chers lecteurs,


L'emploi, dit le dictionnaire, c'est la somme du travail humain effectivement employé et rémunéré. À mesure que le monde se transforme sous l’effet de forces profondes — démographie, transition numérique, contraintes environnementales — la question n’est plus seulement de créer des emplois, mais de savoir où, comment, pour qui et dans quelles conditions.


Cette semaine, nous explorons ces lignes de tension. L’égalité économique entre les femmes et les hommes sera aussi décisive pour améliorer les conditions de vie et soutenir la croissance. La montée en puissance de l’intelligence artificielle, dont le fonctionnement repose sur l'énergie et l'eau, rappelle que les emplois de demain dépendront aussi de choix d’infrastructure compatibles avec des ressources de plus en plus rares. Et lorsque le risque freine l’investissement, les garanties peuvent faire la différence en permettant aux entreprises de s’engager là où l’emploi est le plus nécessaire.


Bonne lecture,






« Si l’on ne fait pas ce qu’il faut, on continuera de courir après les crises, en se contentant de réagir dans l’urgence à des situations que l’on voyait venir depuis des années. » 
Le monde réagit aux crises visibles, mais se transforme sous l’effet de forces plus lentes et plus profondes. D’ici 2050, 85 % de la population mondiale vivra dans les pays en développement. Subject: The Family Who Refused to Put Life on Hold

An extraordinary conversation about curiosity, home, and freedomDear Tudor,

There is a quiet assumption that once children arrive, the horizon narrows. That adventure becomes impractical, that relocation becomes complicated, that curiosity must wait its turn until some more convenient season of life. This week’s lead story gently dismantles that idea.

In 

**Raising a Family in Motion,** I sat down with the Willink family, whose approach to parenting and travel is thoughtful, grounded, and quietly radical in its refusal to see children as a limitation.

Long before they became parents, travel was already woven into how they moved through the world. What makes their story extraordinary is not that they continued exploring after children, but that they integrated their children fully into that rhythm, without apology and without illusion.

They speak openly about compromise, chaos, and the very real negotiations that come with raising young children in motion. They also speak about gratitude, adaptability, and the kind of empathy that only comes from seeing the world firsthand.

For readers who quietly wonder whether a life abroad is still possible with children, or whether family means postponement, this story offers something far more powerful than reassurance. It offers an example. A family that chose to build expansively rather than defensively, and in doing so created something both rooted and free.

One of the quiet strengths of this publication is the depth of lived experience within our readership. If you have built a life across borders with children, or are in the midst of doing so, I would welcome the opportunity to feature more of our readers’ stories in the months ahead.

If you are raising children abroad, considering it, or have already navigated the transition with your family, I would be interested in your experience. What surprised you? What challenged you? What did you gain that you did not anticipate? You can write to me directly

Subject: Red Carpet 2026 Vol. 1 Update: MCP SDK Now Shipping, New EDI SDK, and More!

RED CARPET SUBSCRIPTION UPDATE VOL. 1 2026
The latest update to our signature Red Carpet Subscription is now available! MCP SDK has entered full release and includes robust support for HTTP transport. This update also introduces EDI SDK, NFS client and server components, the full release of our NFC components, new n8n nodes for enterprise workflow automation, and npm distribution for our JavaScript editions:
* MCP SDK Now Shipping (#mcpsdk)
* EDI SDK [Beta] (#edisdk)
* IPWorks NFS [Beta] (#nfs)
* IPWorks NFC Now Shipping (#nfc)
* n8n Node Library [Beta] (#n8n)
* JavaScript Editions (#js)

MCP SDK Now Shipping

MCP SDK (https://www.nsoftware.com/mcpsdk)  streamlines development of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect LLMs to your data, code, and context. MCP SDK is now fully released and includes comprehensive support for HTTP transport in addition to the existing stdio-based communication.

HTTP support enables more flexible deployment of MCP servers, as LLM clients can connect over the network in distributed environments. Our Connecting to Claude (https://www.nsoftware.com/kb/articles/mcpsdk-connecting-with-claude)  guide shows how simple MCP integration over HTTP can be.
EDI SDK [Beta]

EDI SDK (https://www.nsoftware.com/edisdk)  is a new toolkit that simplifies EDI development through EDI Objects: transaction-specific, strongly-typed classes generated from EDI schemas. These classes provide an object-oriented interface for creating, translating, parsing, and validating X12 and EDIFACT documents. By exposing segments, loops, and elements as named properties, EDI Objects eliminate the need for developers to track document position or work directly with low-level EDI data structures.

The getting started guides for X12 (https://www.nsoftware.com/kb/articles/edisdk-x12-edi_objects)  and EDIFACT (https://www.nsoftware.com/kb/articles/edisdk-edifact-edi_objects)  walk through the simple steps for generating document-specific EDI Objects a

INFORMARE

	privind oportunitatea participării la Târgul THAIFEX ANUGA ASIA 2026, în cadrul Pavilionului UE, în perioada 26.05-30.05.2026, în Bangkok (Thailanda)
	Direcția Generală pentru Agricultură și Dezvoltare Rurală (DGAGRI) din cadrul Comisiei Europene informează asupra oportunității participării la Târgul THAIFEX ANUGA ASIA 2026, în cadrul Pavilionului Uniunii Europene. Evenimentul se va desfășura în perioada 26-30 mai 2026, la Bangkok, Thailanda, și reprezintă una dintre cele mai importante platforme de promovare pentru produsele agroalimentare pe piața asiatică. 

	Prin organizarea acestui Pavilion, Uniunea Europeană își propune să crească gradul de conștientizare în rândul consumatorilor thailandezi cu privire la calitatea, siguranța și diversitatea produselor agroalimentare și a băuturilor provenite din UE, în vederea încurajării/stimulării importurilor, al creșterii consumului și al consolidării prezenței acestora pe piața thailandeză.

	Pavilionul va fi organizat sub forma unui stand instituțional, dedicat promovării mesajelor generale privind standardele europene de calitate. În cadrul acestuia se vor regăsi produse agroalimentare reprezentative pentru toate statele membre, din diverse categorii, care vor fi expuse pentru degustare, precum și prezentate în cadrul unor spectacole/demonstrații culinare și prezentări gastronomice susținute pe parcursul evenimentului.

	Pentru a asigura o participare cât mai bine structurată și echilibrată, DGAGRI a pregătit pentru operatorii economici interesați un sondaj cu caracter informativ, disponibil la următorul link: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/thaifexthailand2026 (https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/thaifexthailand2026).

From: Cristian Gheorghe <cristiang.iacob@gmail.com>
To: cumparlegume@gmail.com
Subject: Re: Aviz CM PS PAC nr. 29/2026

Ziua buna Excelentă,

Va multumesc!

OPINIE:

Documentul reprezintă, în esență, o ajustare tehnică a Planului Strategic
PAC, menită să corecteze neclarități apărute în implementare și să alinieze
intervențiile la modificările recente ale legislației europene. Cele mai
importante schimbări sunt în zona sprijinului pentru fermele mici (pag.
16–23), unde se clarifică modul de aplicare al intervenției „Investiții în
fermele de mici dimensiuni”, se introduc limite economice minime (SO)
pentru eligibilitate și se diferențiază intensitatea sprijinului – 55% sau
65% în funcție de dimensiunea fermei. De asemenea, pentru formele
asociative se plafonează sprijinul la 500.000 euro.

Aceste modificări nu sunt doar tehnice, ci au un impact real de politică
agricolă, pentru că direcționează mai clar fondurile către fermele mici și
foarte mici și creează un mecanism mai echilibrat de sprijin diferențiat.

Ca punct de vedere....

Dincolo de ajustările tehnice, modificările arată o repoziționare clară a
sprijinului către fermele mici și foarte mici, cu o încercare de a face
finanțarea mai țintită și mai echitabilă. Introducerea pragurilor economice
(SO minim) filtrează mai riguros beneficiarii și reduce riscul finanțării
unor exploatații neviabile, iar diferențierea intensității sprijinului (55%
vs 65%) indică o orientare social-economică mai accentuată, în favoarea
fermelor cu capacitate investițională redusă.

Plafonarea la 500.000 euro pentru grupuri este, de asemenea, relevantă din
perspectivă strategică: limitează concentrarea excesivă a fondurilor și
obligă la o planificare mai atentă a investițiilor în cadrul formelor
asociative.

Ca punct de vedere profesional, se poate sublinia că aceste modificări
cresc gradul de coerență și control bugetar al intervențiilor, dar în
același timp ridică nivelul de exigență pentru solicitanți – atât din
perspectiva încadrării economice (SO), cât și a fundamentării solide a
planului de afaceri.


Cu st

Diabetul zaharat reprezintă una dintre cele mai mari probleme de sănătate publică ale secolului XXI, datorată occidentalizării modului de viață, îmbătrânirii populaţiei, urbanizării, care au drept consecinţe modificări ale alimentaţiei, adoptarea unui stil de viaţă sedentar şi dezvoltarea obezităţii. Astfel, impactul diabetului zaharat asupra populaţiei este enorm datorită complicaţiilor cronice pe care acesta le poate genera, precum: neuropatia diabetică, boli cardiovasculare (HTA, dislipidemii, insuficiența cardiacă), retinopatia diabetică, sindromul metabolic, nefropatia diabetică, etc.
 
 Această conferință aduce în prim-plan eforturile pe care specialiștii le fac pentru a asigura un management integrat al persoanelor cu diabet zaharat, precum și provocările cu care se confruntă aceștia în prevenția și tratamentul complicațiilor diabetului. Specialiștii din domeniul medical și-au îndreptat atenția către complicaţiile cronice care odată apărute scad calitatea vieţii, capacitatea funcţională, autonomia pacienţilor, cresc numărul zilelor de spitalizare, si al consulturilor medicale. Astfel, reducerea acestor grave consecinţe ale diabetului zaharat este posibilă prin: depistarea precoce activă a persoanelor cu diabet zaharat în grupurile populaţionale cu risc, tratarea pacienţilor odată diagnosticaţi conform protocoalelor terapeutice bazate pe evidenţe internaţionale, prevenirea instală

Subject: Firecrawl Updates: Browser Sandbox, Claude Code Plugin & More

Fully managed browser environment, official Claude Code plugin, 3x faster PDF parsing...  

 

Hey there,

This month, we launched our fully managed browser environment, an official Claude Code integration, and enhancements to data extraction speed and reliability.

 

Browser Sandbox

Browser Sandbox gives you a secure, fully managed browser environment for interactive web automation - no Chromium installs, drivers, or compatibility issues. Each session runs in an isolated, disposable sandbox that scales automatically.

Run Python, JavaScript, or bash remotely; watch sessions in real time; or connect your own Playwright instance over WebSocket. It’s the fastest way to test, debug, and execute browsing tasks safely.

Try it in our Playground ( https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/browser ) now.

( https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/browser )

Claude Code Plugin

Our plugin is now live in Anthropic’s official marketplace. Install it in seconds and fetch web data with Firecrawl directly inside Claude Code.

Learn how to install the plugin ( https://claude.com/plugins/firecrawl ).

( https://claude.com/plugins/firecrawl )

Faster, Smarter PDF Parsing

Our new Rust-based PDF parser delivers up to 3x faster performance and greatly improved reliability. It automatically adapts to any file - from clean text PDFs to complex scanned reports - ensuring accurate, complete data extraction for your agents every time.

Read more in our announcement ( https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/pdf-parser-v2 ).

( https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/pdf-parser-v2 )

Branding Format v2

Branding Format v2 significantly improves logo extraction accuracy, helping you build richer, brand-aware datasets.

Read more in our announcement ( https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/branding-format-v2 ).

( https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/branding-format-v2 )

 

Cheers,

Eric

When we were younger, friendship happened by accident, in classrooms, on sports fields, or with the neighbors who lived next door.

Now, it takes planning, timing, and a kind of courage we don’t talk about enough.

In school, friendship was built into our routines. Now, life is optimized for productivity, not connection: efficient, organized, but quietly isolating.

----------------------

Bună Tudor, 

Pe **2 aprilie** ne revedem la o nouă ediție [**Atelierele Alpha**](https://7vbcp.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LPNKH2jYw4eDHXJAlI/SfY6SxVlnPQy) – o seară dedicată lucrului concret pe ceea ce contează pentru tine ACUM!


Fiecare perioadă din viață aduce o temă centrală. Uneori este o decizie pe care o tot amâni. Alteori este un proiect pe care vrei să îl dezvolți mai curajos. Sau poate este o schimbare personală pe care simți că este timpul să o așezi diferit, mai matur, mai clar, mai asumat.


Imaginează-ți cum e să lucrezi la dorința ta, susținut de energia a peste 80 de oameni aflați în aceeași frecvență!!


**Exercițiul „Beautiful Mind”**
-------------------------------

În cadrul serii vom lucra prin exercițiul „Beautiful Mind”, un proces structurat în **trei pași**, în grupuri de câte trei persoane. 


Este un mod extrem de practic de a pune mintea în Alpha și de a crea claritate prin conectare. 


Când trei **oameni lucrează pe aceeași intenți**e, perspectiva se lărgește, soluțiile apar mai repede, iar energia se **amplifică**natural.


**SURPRIZĂ OMAGIALĂ PENTRU** **RAJKO KUZMANOVI****Ć**
-----------------------------------------------------


Ediția aceasta are pentru noi și o **încărcătură specială**. 


Am pregătit o SURPRIZĂ OMAGIALĂ dedicată lui **Rajko Kuzmanović**, cu respect pentru contribuția lui și pentru impactul pe care l-a avut în viețile multora dintre noi. Dacă ai fost în sală cu el sau dacă munca lui ți-a influențat parcursul, te așteptăm să fim împreună în acest spațiu!


Fie că **ai mai parcurs** programele Silva **sau e prima** ta întâlnire cu această metodă, atelierul te ghidează să lucrezi practic și aplicat cu frecvențele creierului Alpha, Beta și Theta, acele niveluri ale minții unde gândurile se aliniază, intuiția devine clară și transformarea devine posibilă.

which 1 (or 3) are you? I've been sitting with something for a while now. 
Not a framework exactly. More like... a map.

of Mindset Mentor OS http://MindsetMentorAI.com. 

A map of the patterns I keep seeing after thousands of conversations with entrepreneurs who've built real things.

a pattern they can't see. 

An archetype.. 
Something that shapes every decision... 
how they price, how they hire, 
how they show up, what they avoid.

I started mapping these out. 12 of them. 
And every time I share them with someone, they go quiet for a second.

Because they recognize themselves immediately.

So let me walk you through them.

**The Overthinking Achiever.** 
This is the person who knows everything. Read every book. Taken every course. 

Has an opinion on every strategy. 
And yet... nothing moves. 
Not because they're lazy. 
Because they've made preparation a permanent state.
Thinking became the work. 
And doing became the risk. 
They're not building... they're rehearsing. 
Endlessly.

The Burned-Out Builder. 
This one actually built the thing. The revenue is real. The team is real. 

The brand is real. But they're running on fumes. 
The business didn't scale... their exhaustion did. 

They're successful by every external measure and slowly disappearing inside of it. 

That's not a strategy problem. 
That's a frequency problem.

The Invisible Expert. 
Genuinely brilliant at what they do. 
Clients love them. 
Results are undeniable. 
But almost nobody knows they exist. 

They'll tweak the website for the fifteenth time before they'll post a single piece of content that says "here's what I actually believe." 

Visibility feels like exposure. 
Exposure feels like risk. 
So they stay small.

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : AI slop

View Online
________________________________________________________

AI slop [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=535530773&f=1081591&c=27799085&u=77607765 ]

It's not slop because it was created by an AI. It's slop because it's slop.

I just read the first two pages of a sci-fi novel on my Kindle. The author proudly proclaims that the 400-page book was created without any AI whatsoever. Alas, the book is slop. The writing is overwrought and the dialogue is banal. If a page isn't worth writing, it's unlikely a chapter is.

Slop happens when a marketer who should know better stops trying. It's when we prioritize volume over impact. If we measure the cost of what we create instead of its value, it's likely we'll end up with slop.

AI makes this easier, no doubt. But it pays to focus on avoiding slop, not in worrying how the slop is made.

The question is now, “Who approved this?” not “who made this?” • Email to a friend •

And the sooner you recognize where you're at, the faster I can
help you get to the next one.

When it comes to selling in the inbox and making the most out of
your email list, it's important to understand that there are
three distinct areas of focus that need to be conquered.

* List Growth
* Subscriber Monetization
* Scaling Revenue per Subscriber

Think of these as the three pillars holding up your entire email
business.

The second one of them is missing or breaks down, the whole thing
falls apart.

And here's what I see over and over again:

Most list owners are obsessed with one pillar. And completely
ignoring the other two.

You've got the "content creator" type. All-in on list growth.
Running ads. Building funnels. Tweaking opt-in pages at 2am like
a psycho. They'll tell you their list grew by 3,000 last month
with this proud little grin on their face.

Cool. How much did those 3,000 people pay you?

Nothing?

Shocking.

Then you've got the "I have an offer" crowd. They've got
something to sell. Maybe it's great. Probably it's great. But
their emails read like they're apologizing for showing up.

They bury the CTA under a mountain of "value." They send once a
week. Maybe. Because God forbid someone gets annoyed and hits
unsubscribe.

And then there's the person who IS making money from email but
they've hit a wall. Same revenue every month. Same offers. Same
sequences running on autopilot since 2022.

From the outside it looks like it's "working."

But working and optimized? Two very different things.

Here's what you need to understand:

Your email list is not one thing. It's three.

Acquisition. Conversion. Expansion.

Each one takes a different skillset. A different strategy. A
different way of thinking about the people on your list.

List growth is an attention problem.

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>

Subject: Seth's Blog : A nearly perfect score

View Online
________________________________________________________

A nearly perfect score [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=535567465&f=1081591&c=27805773&u=77607765 ]

After playing 498 days in a row, my score today in Bongo was the second-highest in the world:

There's a difference between casual online games that have a right answer, and those that are open-ended.

In crossword puzzles and most of the games from the Times (like Wordle and Connections) you're trying to guess what the puzzle constructor had in mind. This can lead to frustration, because the idiosyncratic nature of inventing clues and answers means that you might not be in sync with the person at the other end. They're inherently closed systems.

Bongo, on the other hand, is generative and combinatorial. There are bazillions of possible right answers, and your goal is to find a right answer that's worth more points than anyone else's. It doesn't matter that I invented the game, I have no advantage over everyone else, because we all begin with the same tiles.

For me, open-ended games are time well spent. Have fun. • Email to a friend •

Lucrez cu companii din Franta, Belgia si Elvetia care cauta sa intre pe piata romaneasca prin achizitii directe. Concret, identific active scoase la vanzare silita in Romania — imobile, terenuri agricole, echipamente industriale, societati comerciale — si le conectez cu cumparatori europeni din acelasi domeniu de activitate.

Investitorul strain aduce capital si acces la piata europeana. Activul din Romania aduce valoare la un pret corect, stabilit prin procedura legala de executare.

MODEL CONTRACT DE COMISION (propunere)

From: Anca și Cristi  <office@focusdevelopment.ro>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Când nu găsești soluția, întoarce-te la baze


[ View in browser](https://7vbcp.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/mr/sh/1t6AVsd2XFnIGGoXpU76WPi61JDfMK/Kic2hJ-FgC4O)

Bună Tudor, 

**Există o regulă simplă în matematică: atunci când o problemă pare imposibil de rezolvat, te întorci la definiții.**


În liceu am avut un profesor care, într-o zi, s-a oprit în fața unei ecuații pe care nici el nu reușea să o ducă la capăt. Clasa era în tăcere. Tensiunea creștea. După câteva minute, a lăsat creta jos și a spus calm: 


###*„Când nu știi să rezolvi o problemă, întoarce-te la baze.”*


A deschis manualul, a reluat conceptele fundamentale, a identificat o formulă pe care o folosise superficial și, în câteva minute, soluția a devenit clară.


Ani mai târziu, aceeași lecție apare într-un alt context. Un antreprenor cu business de milioane ajunge într-un punct de stagnare. Strategiile erau solide, echipa funcționa, piața răspundea. Și totuși, creșterea se plafonase.

**Decizia lui a fost să caute răspunsul la nivel mental.** A mers la un **hipnoterapeut **pentru a identifica programul care genera limita.


**Două contexte diferite. Aceeași lecție.**


**Atunci când ceva se blochează, cauza rar stă în exterior.**
-------------------------------------------------------------


De cele mai multe ori, rădăcina este într-o regulă internă care a funcționat ani de zile fără să fie analizată.


Mintea creează algoritmi de supraviețuire și stabilitate. 


Dacă în perioada de formare s-a instalat ideea că vizibilitatea aduce risc sau că succesul implică pierdere, comportamentul adult va proteja acel echilibru, chiar dacă obiectivul conștient este expansiunea.


La „Manifestă buna ta stare – MBTS” procesul începe exact aici:** la baze**.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Identificarea programelor, aducerea lor în conștiență și recalibrarea lor într-o stare mentală în care schimbarea devine posibilă și stabilă.

Revenirea la fundament nu înseamnă regres. 

**

Recent Copilot updates that change how real work gets done.

( https://github.com )

Below are some recent updates around planning, delegation, subagents, Agent Skills, and more as part of your GitHub Copilot Pro subscription.

Run /plan before large changes
------------------------------

As the session evolves, Copilot automatically compacts context to keep the plan coherent. When work spans multiple files, run /plan in Copilot CLI (or use Shift+Tab to enter plan mode) to generate a reviewable outline of what will change. Use /model to compare strategies across models. Automatic compaction keeps long-running sessions focused. Install Copilot CLI ( npm install -g @github/copilot ) to get started.

Standardize how agents behave
across your team
-----------------------------

AGENTS.md , Agent Skills, and custom agents define shared instructions and tool access so Copilot behaves predictably across sessions, models, workflows, and contributors. This is useful when multiple engineers are delegating work into the same repo.

Get started → ( https://docs.github.com/copilot/reference/customization-cheat-sheet?utm_source=lcm-mpu-dev-pro-get-started-Pro_O1_Day1&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=FY26MAR-WW-LCM-PL-Free-Pro-PP-AA-Dev-TX-MPU )

/delegate work and review a draft PR

From: El Socio del Mundo from El Socio del Mundo <elsociodelmundo@substack.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Antes de volver a escribirte, quería decirte esto.

View this post on the web at https://elsociodelmundo.substack.com/p/antes-de-volver-a-escribirte-queria

Hola socio,
Si este correo te tomó por sorpresa, lo entiendo.
Este Substack está apoyado por los lectores. Para recibir nuevos posts y apoyar mi trabajo, considera convertirte en un suscriptor de contenido gratis o un suscriptor de pago.
Durante varios años envié este boletín desde otra plataforma mientras construía cursos, proyectos y distintas iniciativas.
Hace unos meses dejé de escribir con regularidad… y en ese silencio también pasaron muchas cosas.
Entre ellas, algo importante para mí: terminé y presenté en la FIL Guadalajara un libro llamado “400 Empresas”.
El proceso de escribirlo me cambió más de lo que esperaba.
Porque después de estudiar cientos de empresas, conversaciones con emprendedores y experiencias propias, entendí algo que ahora quiero explorar contigo de una forma distinta:
No se trata solo de crear negocios.
Se trata de aprender a pensar como alguien que puede construirlos una y otra vez.
Por eso decidí mover este boletín a una nueva casa: Substack.
Un espacio más simple, más directo y más personal para escribir sin algoritmos ni ruido.
Algo importante (y quiero ser transparente)
Al hacer la migración, importé mi base de suscriptores anterior.
Eso significa que quizá en algún momento te registraste, leíste algún correo mío o formaste parte de esta comunidad… incluso si hace tiempo dejaste de seguirla.
Si hoy ya no quieres recibir estos mensajes, puedes darte de baja aquí sin problema alguno: 👉 link de unsubscribe al final del correo.
De verdad: sin resentimientos y gracias por haber estado en algún momento.
Pero si decides quedarte, quiero hacerlo bien esta vez.
Lo que recibirás a partir de ahora
Una vez por semana escribiré una carta breve sobre:
ideas que cambian cómo pensamos los negocios
aprendizajes reales de emprendedores y empresas
neurociencia aplicada a decisiones empresariales
sistemas para construir empresa

Attachments: 07e8d03b-1567-11f1-a6f2-883d24f4fc44.csv

Hello Cumpar,

We’re writing to let you know that Cloud Observability has launched a new  
OpenTelemetry (OTel) ingestion API[1] that supports native OpenTelemetry  
Protocol (OTLP) logs, trace spans, and metrics. Starting March 4, 2026,  
this API will be added as a dependency for the current Cloud Logging, Cloud  
Trace, and Cloud Monitoring ingestion APIs. This change ensures a seamless  
transition as collection tools migrate to this new unified endpoint.

What you need to know

Key changes:

    - The existing Cloud Observability ingestion APIs  
(logging.googleapis.com, cloudtrace.googleapis.com, and  
monitoring.googleapis.com) are automatically activated when you create a  
Google Cloud project using the Google Cloud console or gcloud CLI. The  
behavior remains unchanged for projects created via API, which do not have  
these ingestion APIs enabled by default. Starting March 4, 2026, the new  
OTel ingestion endpoint telemetry.googleapis.com will automatically  
activate when any of these specified APIs are enabled.
    - In addition, we will automatically enable this new endpoint for all  
existing projects that already have current ingestion APIs active.

What you need to do

No action is required from you for this API enablement change, and there  
will be no disruption to your existing services. You may disable the API at  
any time by following these instructions[2].

Refer to the attachment for a list of the projects that will automatically  
enable the new endpoint.

We’re here to help

If you have any questions or require assistance, please contact Google  
Cloud Support[3].

Thanks for choosing Google Cloud Observability.

– The Google Cloud Team

https://docs.cloud.google.com/stackdriver/docs/reference/telemetry/overview
[2] https://docs.cloud.google.com/service-usage/docs/enable-disable

The gap between “I” and “no one” [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=535781209&f=1081591&c=27842901&u=77607765 ]

This is where empathy lies, and it's an easy chasm to fall into.

“I can't imagine eating durian ice cream,” is not the same as “no one likes durian ice cream.”

We fail as marketers, editors and project managers when we can't find the empathy to bridge the gap. It's a lovely shortcut to make things for yourself, to imagine that you are the client, the reader or the customer. But most of the time, you're not.

From: Jacob Suckow <jacob@emailempire.org>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: why the market seems "different"

I’ve been working on some dope stuff behind the scenes the past
week or two…

Using the same systems that have crushed in the inbox and turning
out ad campaigns, social posts, webinars and workshops at a wild
clip.

And the reason is because all of the principals hold true across
the board.

Which also means…

That if you want to take the same things that are working for you
on other channels…

And pump them into your email list, you can do that with a pretty
good chance of success.

As long as you understand the channel.

It’s something that’s really been making me think lately…

The market is becoming more sophisticated than ever before.

And we’re hitting a point where people are craving “experience”
before they buy.

They want to see, hear, feel, taste and even believe what your
product has to offer before they actually pull the trigger.

I saw a post this evening that hit on this really, really well.

And it put words to a lot of what I’ve been shifting in our most
successful campaigns for clients…

More consumption assets have become the number one factor for
success.

More value dense emails…

More immediate use lead magnets…

More webinars and workshops…

More videos…

All to share the “experience” of working with you and buying from
you before your leads ever swipe their card.

It’s harder to pull off well, no doubt…

But it also makes for MUCH stickier buyers when done right.

We have clients selling $35k packages in full straight from a VSL
funnel on cold traffic.

But it works because of every piece of “experience” content that
we have in the machine.

Every post…

Every email…

And every clip…

All contribute to the experience a lead has in their head when it
comes time to buy.

So, I challenge you…

Go through your content and genuinely ask yourself “On a scale of
1-10, how good is the “experience” before someone ever buys from
me?”

And if it’s less than a ten…

I guarantee yo

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : The Uncanny Valley

View Online
________________________________________________________

The Uncanny Valley [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=536001097&f=1081591&c=27879093&u=77607765 ]

It used to be an obscure oddity, now we all need to understand it.

18 years ago, I posted this image:

…and I still can't get it out of my head. Sorry.

Why do we have such a creeped-out reaction to images that aren't quite right? A robot that looks too much like a person, or a song that we can somehow tell has an AI voice.

The creepiness predates AI, and was first named in a paper by Mori fifty years ago. But it's so visceral that it almost certainly originated along with our fear of snakes and other evolutionary safeguards.

There are probably two things going on.

First, there's a corpse alert. Corpses are dangerous, and something that's alive/not alive is a warning sign. Same thing with zombies.

Second, imposter alert. Imposters are even more dangerous than predators, and we honed our imposter-detection skills a long time ago.

And now, everyone has AI available to them, and many of us are churning out experiences that border on the uncanny valley.

Not many people care about an automated drum track on a pop single, but we get uncomfortable when the lead singer isn't quite human. We don't mind when a website figures out our zip code for us, but when a bot apologizes for a late shipment, it means less than nothing. We're okay with animation, but not with an educational video that combines beautifully shot real footage with an animated human that's almost but not quite real…

While it's possible to get used to snakes, and, perhaps, to corpses, I'm not sure that the general population is in any hurry to get used to either, or to the uncanny valley.

From: Jacob Suckow <jacob@emailempire.org>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: 6fig email biz on a napkin

Here's the simplest roadmap to a 6-figure online business:

Facebook ad. Opt-in. Daily emails. Sales page.

That's it.

No funnel gymnastics. No 90-day nurture sequences. No "let's stay
in touch" BS.

Just a clean pipeline from stranger to customer.

We've printed millions using this exact setup across 47+
industries. Every client who runs it and actually sticks to it?
Money flows.

But here's what I see from most people:

They build complex funnels that nobody finishes.

They send weekly newsletters that nobody reads.

They "nurture" for months while their leads slowly forget they
exist.

Then they wonder why nobody buys.

Here's something that'll rewire how you think about this.

At any given time, only 3-5% of your list is actually ready to
buy.

So when you send one email a week with one angle on one offer...
you're only ever catching a tiny sliver of the people who could
say yes.

The solution isn't a better email. It's more emails with more
offers presented more often.

One of our clients switched from 3x/week to daily. Lost 900
subscribers. Doubled their revenue. Went from $31K/month to $73K.

Not because the emails got better. Because more of the right
people saw the right offer at the right time.

Listen...

You don't need new products to make new offers. You just need new
angles on the ones that already work. The offer isn't dead. You
just ran out of ways to talk about it.

More emails. More angles. More asks.

That's the whole game.

Your email list is either printing money or costing you money.
And every day you don't send is revenue walking out the door.

So when someone tells me "I'm still trying to figure it out..."

Nah. You're stalling.

The blueprint is right here 👇

Rising costs and new visa pathways for building a life overseashttps://www.escapeartist.com/ 

Dear Tudor,

In this week’s Plan-B Newsletter, we’re leaning into the kind of coverage I care most about: the practical realities that shape life abroad after the excitement of the decision.

We begin with my latest piece, 

**Inflation Abroad Is Changing Life Overseas**, which looks at how rising costs are reshaping expat life in 2026. Moving overseas used to come with a built-in assumption that “there” would remain reliably cheaper than “here,” but the gap is narrowing in ways that are uneven, local, and often invisible until you’re living inside it. 

Alongside it, we look at a development making waves across the remote work world: 

**S**ri Lanka Joins the Digital Nomad Visa Boom. Digital nomad visas can generate plenty of headlines, but what matters is how a program fits into the country’s broader direction: stability, infrastructure, and whether the pathway is designed for real long-stay life rather than marketing imagery. Sri Lanka’s entry into this space is stirring interest for a reason, and we break down what’s known so far and what to watch as the program takes shape.

Until next time

Ish

From: SCHWEIZER Cyrille <cyrille.schweizer@dgtresor.gouv.fr>
To: fruitnature4@gmail.com
Subject: Veille bimensuelle Agro / BG -HU - RO N° 4 - 5 mars 2026
Attachments: image001.jpg, Veille Agri BG HU RO - n°4 - 5 mars 2026.pdf, Veille agricole HU fev 26.pdf

Bonjour à tous,

Je vous prie de bien vouloir trouver ci-joint la  veille bimensuelle pour la Bulgarie, la Hongrie et la Roumanie au 5 mars.
Elle est complétée par la veille agricole dédiée pour la Hongrie pour le mois de février transmise par le Service économique de Budapest.

Vous en souhaitant bonne réception




Résumé :



En Bulgarie, le nouveau ministre de l’agriculture, par intérim, Ivan Hristanov rappelle ses priorités et celle de son équipe rapprochée : soutenir les agriculteurs, garantir des conditions propices à des élections équitables, lutter contre la corruption, élaborer des politiques durables garantissant la sécurité et la prévisibilité pour les agriculteurs et la société bulgares. ------------------------------------------------------------
05/03/2026

APADOR-CH îi cere Președintelui României să clarifice chestiunea „umbrelei nucleare” oferite de Franța și, în cazul în care asta înseamnă amplasarea sau staționarea de arme pe teritoriul țării, să organizeze un referendum național


Asociația Pentru Apărarea Drepturilor Omului în România – Comitetul Helsinki (APADOR-CH) a transmis astăzi o scrisoare oficială Președintelui României, prin care solicită deplină transparență și consultarea cetățenilor în legătură cu inițiativa Franței de a include și România sub „umbrela sa nucleară”.

În contextul informațiilor recente, privind invitarea României la discuții pe această temă, și a anunțului unor oficiali, cum că subiectul va fi analizat în cadrul Consiliului Suprem de Apărare a Țării (CSAT), APADOR-CH consideră că o decizie de o asemenea gravitate nu poate fi luată exclusiv de politicieni împreună cu serviciile de informații.


Prin urmare i-am cerut Președintelui României următoarele:
1. Lămurirea publică, cu deplină claritate, a obligațiilor exacte care ar reveni României în cazul acceptării „umbrelei nucleare” oferite de Franța, eliminând orice ambiguități legate de termeni precum „partajare nucleară” sau „descurajare avansată”.
2. Organizarea unui referendum național înainte de luarea oricărei decizii, în cazul în care propunerea franceză implică amplasarea sau staționarea de arme nucleare pe teritoriul României.

input:
From: Jacob Suckow <jacob@emailempire.org>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Time for another funeral

Every few years there’s this “mass reckoning” that happens in the
online business world.

I’ve been around for a few of them…

But I’ve been around guys and gals that have been around for 5-10
of them and by now, I think I know better than to ignore
patterns.

Because every one of them have war stories of the “glory days”
for every advertising channel and marketing strategy under the
sun.

The early days of ppc and SEO supremacy…

The surgical targeting and charity rate cpm’s on Facebook/Meta…

Even the email gold rush of the early 2000’s…

Then, eventually, those seasons end and everyone who took
advantage of them is shouting from the rooftops that another
golden goose is “dead”.

Most people believe them too…

Had a lady tell me just a few weeks ago that because she’d tried
1 contractor and burned $5k on them that “her list won’t buy,
never will, and email is a lost cause”.

Sad day.

Because from the numbers she was doing on social, there was
easily another $20-$30k/mo just waiting for her in that list.

But I digress.

The doomsayers are out again.

And they’re waving their signs louder and prouder than the
Westboro Baptist Church (remember them?)

In the past 72 hours I’ve seen:

“the coaching industry is dying”

“High ticket products are dead”

“You can’t sell info anymore”

“If you can’t sell low ticket, they won’t pay for the big stuff”

“Email is dead, sms is king”

“VSL’s don’t work like they used to”

Sad part is some poor soul is gonna see one of these ignorant
proclamations and believe it.

And they’ll struggle because they just removed a valuable tool
from their arsenal.

The truth behind these statements sits a little deeper…

What people mean when they say things lie that isn’t that “X
doesn’t work anymore”…

It’s that it’s gotten harder to get them working and keep them
profitable.

If anyone took an extra two seconds to dull down their rapture
talk, and make that clarification…

Tight rope standing [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=536382509&f=1081591&c=27928521&u=77607765 ]

It's much easier to walk a tight rope than it is to simply stand in place.

Forward momentum creates stability. • Email to a friend •

That's what studies are for [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=536382513&f=1081591&c=27928521&u=77607765 ]

“Are you sure it's going to work?”

That's the wrong question to consider when proposing a study.

It's also not helpful to say, “It's unlikely to solve the problem.”

All the likely approaches have already been tried.

The useful steps are:

- Is there a problem worth solving?
- Is the expense of this test reasonable?
- Will the study cause significant damage?
- Of all the things we can test, is this a sensible one to try next?

Our fear of failure is real. It's often so significant that we'd rather live with a problem than face the possibility that our new approach might be wrong.

If the problem is worth solving, it's probably worth the effort and risk that the next unproven test will require.

[In this podcast, Dr. Jonathan Sackner-Bernstein talks with some patients and a doctor about his novel approach to Parkinson's disease. Participants in the conversation bring up the conventional wisdom he's challenging and share reasons why his theory probably won't work. But none of the critics has a better alternative. The cost of the test is relatively low, and the stakes of the problem are quite high. There's no clear answer. This is precisely what a study is for.]

What will it cost to test your solution to our problem? Okay, begin. • Email to a friend •

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Confused about donations

View Online
________________________________________________________

Confused about donations [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=536746300&f=1081591&c=27971944&u=77607765 ]

A suite at a New York Knicks game costs more than $30,000. Is that a donation to the team?

Why do we differentiate between the money spent on a Super Bowl ticket and the check we write for a worthy cause?

Does calling it a “donation” make it more valuable or less valuable to us?

Fundraisers can fall into the trap of believing that they're asking for a favor or begging for a donation. But human beings, like all creatures, exchange time, money or risk in exchange for something. When that exchange is insufficient to cause action, we don't do it.

The anonymous donor gets something. They get something priceless, memorable and worthwhile: peace of mind.

The public donor, whether it's the neighbor buying a raffle ticket for the scout fundraiser or the bigwig on the board of a museum, they get something as well. The status and connection they buy is a bargain, worth more than it costs. In fact, if it wasn't worth more than it costs, they wouldn't buy it.

The fundraiser isn't asking for a favor. They're offering an opportunity. • Email to a friend •

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Considering infinity

View Online
________________________________________________________

Considering infinity [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=536878664&f=1081591&c=27999196&u=77607765 ]

Endless, unlimited and more. These are building blocks of capitalism.

Starbucks knows that they can't get you to drink three coffees every morning, but their stock price is built on the idea that they can continue to get more customers and make more money from each one.

The Wedding-Industrial complex is built on the simple idea that your wedding should cost the same as your best friend's wedding did (plus a little more).

The status ratchet is real, and it's easy to be seduced by it. “Compared to what” is a fundamental component of marketing.

One reason this works is that a little progress gets you positive feedback, which makes you eager to find a little more, a cycle that doesn't end. Infinity, all the way up.

And, for those seeking social change, the opposite is worth noting:

When asking for penance, self-control and good behavior, infinity is not a useful tool. When someone shows up and tries to do better, “that's not good enough,” is not a particularly useful motivator.

The useful process begins by earning enrollment in the journey toward better, but it's not amplified by our criticism of each action being imperfect.

Go-up infinity is about 'more.' But too often, social-good infinity is about 'pure'. And pure is difficult to embrace, because anything less than pure feels like failure. • Email to a friend •

From: Jørgen Villadsen  <jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu>
To: office@cumparlegume.com
Subject: SV: Cooperation opportunity for TL Concept Nordic ApS,
Attachments: image001.jpg, Flyer TLC English 2025.pdf

Dear Tudor,

As a follow-up to our pleasant and informative talk this morning and as promised I send you an e-mail to clarify a few issues and help you to potentially move forward with identifying possibilities.

You already visited our web page www.tlconcept.eu<http://www.tlconcept.eu> and furthermore then I have attached a company flyer to this e-mail in order to give you an indication where we could potentially start a co-operation.

To give you an insight to normal rising questions I have written down a few myself and the answers as well.

  1.  Preferred nationalities? It has to be EU citizens with valid working permissions Required language and to what extent? A team should have one person who speaks English (in Germany: German)
  2.  Number of employees and by when? We should start with a team of 4-5 insulators including a foreman that is responsible for the team when you have them in place. Rather quality than finding them fast
  3.  What positions do you need people for? All levels, cladders, insulators, foremen, Site Manager, Project Manager What qualifications must employees have? See below
  4.  Is the work shift-based? We have three different rotation models: Fulltime per week – 10:4: Work from Monday to the next week Wednesday at lunch, then time off until the following Monday – 2-1 = 2 weeks of work and one week off.
  5.  Place of employment? Might be best to test for Germany. Denmark and other countries can then come later.
  6.  Legalisation of employees? We expect that the candidates or you take care of the process. We can lead you in the right direction but do not initially want to be involved in this process more than absolutely necessary.

Just to be clear our focus will be ONLY on technical insulators – no house insulation with Rockwool or Paroc but pipes and ducts in clean room environment – Armaflex is a must Techlite or Cleantech Lite experience is a big plus! We are not going to teach staff they need to be plug-and-play. Lan

input:
From: El Socio del Mundo from El Socio del Mundo <elsociodelmundo@substack.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Vendió su empresa, levantó inversión… y nadie compró

View this post on the web at https://elsociodelmundo.substack.com/p/vendio-su-empresa-levanto-inversion

Hace unos días me encontré con un amigo emprendedor en Guadalajara.
Hace algunos años había vendido su empresa.
Este Substack está apoyado por los lectores. Para recibir nuevos posts y apoyar mi trabajo, considera convertirte en un suscriptor de contenido gratis o un suscriptor de pago.
No era una venta pequeña.
Había logrado lo que muchos emprendedores persiguen durante años: construir algo, hacerlo crecer y salir con éxito.
Estaba capitalizado.
Y como suele pasar después de una venta exitosa, tenía una idea clara:
volver a hacerlo.
Crear otra empresa.
Escalarla.
Y eventualmente venderla también.
El plan era repetir la fórmula del emprendedor serial.
Durante un tiempo, parecía que todo iba exactamente así.
El segundo emprendimiento
Decidió invertir una parte importante del capital que había obtenido —junto con dinero de un inversionista ángel— en una nueva startup tecnológica.
Contrataron equipo.
Desarrolladores.
Operaciones.
Marketing.
La nómina mensual rondaba los 150 mil pesos.
La idea parecía lógica:
construir una plataforma para ayudar a vendedores a crecer dentro de Amazon.
El mercado era enorme.
Las conversaciones iniciales eran prometedoras.
Pero el producto no salió en un mes.
Ni en tres.
Ni en seis.
Pasó casi un año completo.
El dinero empezó a agotarse antes de que el producto llegara al mercado.
Y cuando finalmente estuvo listo…
nadie lo compró.
La frase que lo explicó todo
Mientras caminábamos por la Vía Recreativa y luego tomábamos café, me dijo algo que se me quedó grabado.
“Validamos con todos… menos con quienes realmente iban a pagar.”
Habían hablado con Amazon.
Con expertos del ecosistema.
Con personas de la industria.
Todos decían lo mismo:
“La idea suena muy bien.”
Pero nunca validaron profundamente con los vendedores finales.
Los clientes reales.
No probaron disposición de pago.
No hicieron experim

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Small changes to big systems

View Online
________________________________________________________

Small changes to big systems [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=536972332&f=1081591&c=28026744&u=77607765 ]

A hardcover book printed in 1925 is almost indistinguishable from one printed yesterday. It's easy to think not much has changed.

But book publishing isn't about printing, and it's a useful metaphor for the systems changes we're seeing all around us.

The book publishing system was based on scarcity.

A successful bookstore was perfect. It had exactly the right number of books — more wouldn't fit, and fewer wouldn't pay the rent. The only way for a book publisher to get a new book into the stores was to get the bookseller to take an old book out.

As a result of this chokepoint, distribution became the focus. Publishers came to see bookstores, not readers, as their customers—which is why there are few ads for books, or toll-free numbers to call. There were plenty of authors, so publishers selected which ones got a distribution investment. And their timing and launch strategies all revolved around the bookstores.

Bookstores have to make smart choices. Months in advance, they choose which new books to take on (and which to leave behind.) If they were wrong, if a new book they don't carry has an audience, then they lose sales because readers go elsewhere.

The small change? Get rid of the scarcity of shelf space. Amazon never removes a book to make room for a new book. They have all the books.

The publishers' existing strategies make little sense when the scarcity of shelf space goes away.

One industry term is the “lay down” which describes how many books a major publisher needs to print and distribute to get good nationwide coverage at launch. For books that hope to be bestsellers, that number was 25,000 copies or so… a book from a well-known author would have that many copies in the world before a single copy was sold.

Clean water where it’s needed
From a lack of clean drinking water, to droughts that hurt agricultural production, to flooding and violent storms that destroy homes and roads, water is a constant pressing issue in many regions around the world.

Countries are having a hard time improving water supplies, in part because they also are struggling with other big problems such as poverty, conflict or migration. Investment in water and sanitation projects is lower than needed to achieve the UN Sustainable Development Goal of providing water and sanitation [https://www.un.org/sustainabledevelopment/water-and-sanitation/] for all by 2030.

The European Investment Bank (EIB) is one of the largest lenders to the global water sector [https://www.eib.org/en/publications/water-overview-2021?utm_source=mailjet&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=EIB-Global-April&utm_content=na], investing close to €79 billion in over 1 600 projects over the last 60 years. The Bank is improving the water situation in many countries [https://www.eib.org/en/essays/creative-development-solutions?utm_source=mailjet&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=EIB-Global-April&utm_content=na] by investing in local and regional projects that improve drinking water networks and by financing modern treatment plants to make water safer and more accessible.

In December 2021, the EIB financed the construction of a treatment plant and a network of pipelines that will supply clean water to 1.6 million people in the Jordan Valley [https://www.eib.org/en/press/all/2021-470-jordanian-ministers-welcome-eur-70-million-eib-support-to-improve-use-of-scarce-water-in-the-jordan-valley?utm_source=mailjet&utm_me

📋 Ce s-a mai schimbat
------------------------

Verificări suplimentare la firmele cu datorii 🔄

Guvernul a adoptat pe 5 martie o Ordonanță de urgență care închide o portiță folosită la cesiunile de părți sociale atunci când firma are datorii la stat și mai taie din hârtii în relația cu ANAF.

Cum stăteau lucrurile până acum

Regula introdusă prin Legea 239/2025 ( https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/305208 ) viza situațiile în care se schimba controlul în firmă. Și asta tocmai ca să nu mai poată ieși formal dintr-o firmă cu datorii fix asociatul care conduce și să lase în urmă firma cu obligații neachitate.

Dar aceeași regulă nu se aplica și dacă transferul era făcut de un alt asociat (minoritar), iar asta a lăsat loc de manevră și ocolișuri.

📌 Ce s-a schimbat

Prin OUG 13/2026 ( https://legislatie.just.ro/public/DetaliiDocument/308122 ), regula devine generală și nu mai este legată de control: cesiunea părților sociale ale oricărui asociat trebuie să fie opozabilă organului fiscal în aceleași condiții. Mai simplu spus, orice transfer de părți sociale, inclusiv al asociaților minoritari, intră în mecanism, nu doar cesiunea asociatului care deține controlul.

* Notificarea ANAF, în 15 zile de la cesiune: notificarea poate fi făcută de cedent, cesionar sau firmă.

From: Escape Artist <editors@mail.escapeartist.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Plan-B Newsletter: Europe’s New Residency Reality

Why the financial bar for expats is climbinghttps://www.escapeartist.com/ 

Dear Tudor,

In this week’s Plan-B Newsletter, we’re zoning in on Europe, a region many of our readers continue to watch closely as they think about building a life abroad.

I wrote our lead story this week, 

**Europe’s Residency Thresholds Are Changing**, as the landscape across the continent is changing quickly. Countries like Portugal, Spain, and Greece built enormous appeal with accessible residency programs, but the financial thresholds for entry are rising across the continent. Housing pressure, inflation, and political shifts are all pushing governments to tighten the rules. For anyone planning a European move, understanding this shift early is critical.

Alongside it, we published a marvellous piece on 

**Growing Older Abroad**, which looks at something every global citizen eventually has the privilege of experiencing: a long life. Building a life overseas isn’t just about where you want to live next, but where you want to grow older with comfort and community. The piece explores how expats can think strategically about healthcare, long-term care, and social support so that the life they build abroad today continues to work decades from now.

Taken together, these pieces look at the same question from two angles: how to secure your place abroad today, and how to make sure that life remains sustainable there over time.

As always, I’d love to hear what you’re working toward right now. If Europe is on your radar, or if you’re thinking more seriously about the long-term mechanics of life abroad, write to me at isha@escapeartist.com mailto:isha@escapeartist.com. I read every message.

Until next time

Isha Sesay

Editor-in-Chief, 

**Escape Artist**

https://www.escapeartist.com/subscribe/

From: Anca și Cristi  <office@focusdevelopment.ro>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Ce legătură are fizica cuantică cu bunăstarea ta?


[ View in browser](https://7vbcp.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/mr/sh/1t6AVsd2XFnIGGoXpU76WPi61JDfMK/HmDJLPKzC53-)

Bună Tudor, 

În fizica cuantică există un concept fascinant: **saltul cuantic**.


În lumea microscopică a particulelor, energia unui sistem rămâne stabilă într-o anumită stare până în momentul în care apare o reorganizare bruscă. Într-o fracțiune de secundă, sistemul trece într-o stare energetică diferită.


Fizicienii descriu acest proces ca pe o **reconfigurare instantanee a structurii energetice**.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Pentru observatorul exterior, schimbarea apare brusc.
Pentru sistem, reorganizarea reprezintă rezultatul unei acumulări de energie și informație care pregătesc acel moment.


**Acest principiu a inspirat numeroși cercetători din domeniul psihologiei și al conștiinței umane.**


Pentru că și în lumea interioară a oamenilor apar **momente în care o reorganizare a percepției produce schimbări rapide în modul în care cineva gândește, decide și acționează.**


Un tipar mental poate rămâne activ ani întregi.

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Henry Ford knew how to drive

View Online
________________________________________________________

Henry Ford knew how to drive [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=537229128&f=1081591&c=28075164&u=77607765 ]

He also understood the process of organizing a plant to build a car.

Scott Belsky knows how to use Photoshop and remembers what it was like to run a small business.

And Sarah Jones knows exactly what is required to be on stage, alone, in a crowded theater.

The world keeps changing (faster than ever) and leading our team (and our career) requires us to do things we didn't used to know how to do.

In essence, the CEO of every organization, of every size, is more incompetent than ever before. It's not enough to know how to use the product and have empathy for your customers.

Are you making decisions about AI, supply chains, vendor management, the sales pipeline or employee health?

It's hard to wing it if you haven't flown before, and now most of what CEOs do (even for companies of one or two people) has little to do with the actual product or service on offer.

One alternative is to freak out, bury your head and hope for the best.

The other is to use the system to learn about the system. Instead of winging it, find the time to learn enough to make good decisions and to understand the tools well enough to benefit from hiring people to use them.

Because that's what CEOs make. They make decisions. • Email to a friend •

From: "Seth Godin" <notify@sethgodin.com>
To: apaminerala@yahoo.com
Subject: Seth's Blog : Over the top

View Online
________________________________________________________

Over the top [ https://p.feedblitz.com/r3.asp?l=537262936&f=1081591&c=28083508&u=77607765 ]

Unreasonable commitment is unreasonable. It happens before there's a guarantee it will work. It's out of proportion to what others think is standard. Unreasonable commitment is dedication, persistence, care, energy, connection and investment that doesn't seem to make sense.

You can't do this in everything, and you probably can't do it all the time. That's why it's unreasonable to expect.

I've been fortunate enough to do hundreds of podcasts. The hosts are even kinder and more professional than you'd imagine, showing up for months or years with virtually no listeners. They do it because they care.

But only one podcast host had me in tears before we began recording.

Last September, I spent the day with Mel Robbins and her team of more than a dozen professionals. We recorded for four hours, two episodes worth, and then they quietly spent six months editing the work.

Mel's even more Mel-like in person. She's fully present, committed and yes, over the top. Our conversation led to my new book and course, and it also reminded me that better is possible. Not just for the person in front of the camera, but for everyone on the team, for the guests and for the people listening.

Neil Pasricha wrote about Mel a decade ago. Before last year's bestseller or the Golden Globe nomination or the podcast hit its stride. It's a choice.

Unreasonable commitment doesn't seem like a good plan until after it works.• Email to a friend •

Avem cerere pentru produse montane certificate, pentru distributie in Franta si Romania.
Daca sunteti interesat sa vindeti acum, va rog sa ne trimiteti:
- Lista produselor disponibile

Comisia Europeana finanteaza programe de promovare a produselor agricole prin programul AGRIP.

Ce se finanteaza:
- Participare la targuri internationale (SIAL Paris, Anuga, Fruit Logistica)
- Campanii de promovare pe piata interna UE si tari terte
- Materiale promotionale, standuri, degustari
- Cofinantare UE: 70-80% din costuri

Tipuri de programe:
- Program simplu (o tara, un beneficiar sau consortiu)
- Program multinational (mai multe tari UE - cofinantare mai mare)

Deadline depunere: 23 Aprilie 2026, ora 17:00 CET

>
> 1. VANZARE IMEDIATA - EXPORT FRANTA
>
> Avem cerere pentru produse montane certificate, pentru distributie in
> Franta si Romania.
> Daca sunteti interesat sa vindeti acum, va rog sa ne trimiteti:

> - Preturile pentru en-gros / export (cantitati mari, nu bucata)
> - Capacitatea de livrare lunara
>

>
> Comisia Europeana finanteaza programe de promovare a produselor agricole
> prin programul AGRIP.
>
> Ce se finanteaza:
> - Participare la targuri internationale (SIAL Paris, Anuga, Fruit
> Logistica)
> - Campanii de promovare pe piata interna UE si tari terte
> - Materiale promotionale, standuri, degustari
> - Cofinantare UE: 70-80% din costuri
>
> Tipuri de programe:
> - Program simplu (o tara, un beneficiar sau consortiu)
> - Program multinational (mai multe tari UE - cofinantare mai mare)
>
> Deadline depunere: 23 Aprilie 2026, ora 17:00 CET
>
> Cooperativa noastra va depune un program de promovare pentru produse

>

>

> contacta cand vom avea oportunitati noi.
>
> Cu stima,
> Tudor Seicares
